title: InformationRetentionReport.v1
description: The lossless audit for one transform/run: did the system retain everything it must? Counts the inputs/outputs/held-out/rejected, measures source-handle coverage (must be 1.0 — 100% — for served artifacts), counts dropped source handles (must be 0 to be promotable), counts orphaned inputs/outputs (0 or explained), and records whether raw rehydration passed and lineage is complete. lossy_transform_declared marks a deliberately lossy text-surface compression; it must NOT be allowed (lossy_transform_allowed false) for truth-bearing facts. safe_to_promote is the conjunction of all the lossless gates and is enforced by check_information_retention_report.

held_out_count.description: items held out by the transform; >0 is fine, they remain rehydratable

source_handle_coverage.description: fraction of served outputs with a resolvable source handle; must be 1.0 for a promotable served artifact

dropped_source_handle_count.description: source handles lost across the transform; must be 0 to be promotable

orphaned_input_count.description: inputs with no output lineage; 0 or explained

orphaned_output_count.description: outputs with no input lineage; 0 or explained

raw_rehydration_passed.description: outputs walk back to the raw layer

lineage_complete.description: every required lineage link resolved, no empty handle

lossy_transform_declared.description: the transform deliberately shrank the text surface

lossy_transform_allowed.description: MUST be false for truth-bearing facts; a lossy declared transform on truth that is allowed is rejected

safe_to_promote.description: the conjunction: coverage 1.0 AND 0 dropped handles AND raw_rehydration_passed AND lineage_complete AND NOT (lossy declared AND allowed on truth)
